Service

Hotel booking from Pakistan

Get a quote

What is included in our hotel booking service?

We book hotels across Pakistan and abroad at negotiated rates, from budget guest houses in Hunza to 5-star stays in Dubai and Istanbul. Rooms are confirmed in writing, and we can pay in PKR on your behalf, which avoids card fees and exchange surprises.

What you get

  • Negotiated rates
  • Room-type advice
  • Early check-in requests
  • Group blocks

How booking works

  1. 1

    Tell us your plan

    Share dates, budget and travellers through the form or WhatsApp — it takes two minutes.

  2. 2

    Get options in 30 minutes

    A travel advisor sends 2–3 clear options with total prices in PKR, no hidden fees.

  3. 3

    Confirm & pay securely

    Pay by bank transfer, card or mobile wallet. Tickets and vouchers arrive on WhatsApp and email.

  4. 4

    Travel with backup

    A real person answers 24/7 on WhatsApp while you travel, from flight delays to hotel changes.

FAQ

Hotel booking: common questions
